BrochureContent.Content:
Kavanagh Estates are delighted to bring this delightful 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom property to the market for sale. Nestled in the sought-after, well-established coastal development of Seamount Village this property offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Boasting a bright and spacious open-plan layout, the kitchen/dining/living area is the heart of the home, featuring large sliding doors that flood the space with natural light and open onto the garden/patio area.

The remainder of the ground floor of this property features two double bedrooms and a bathroom. Upstairs, there are two additional bedrooms and a second bathroom. All bedrooms are equipped with built-in wardrobes, providing ample storage space.

Located within a small, secure development with a barrier entrance, this property is just a short stroll to the beach and close to all the amenities of Riverchapel Village. With the M11 motorway and Gorey Town Centre less than a 5-minute drive away, this home offers excellent connectivity while maintaining a relaxed coastal charm.

Key Features:
Accommodation: Four double bedrooms, including two conveniently located downstairs.
Living Space: Open-plan kitchen/dining/living area.
Downstairs bathroom:
Heating: Electric storage heating throughout the home plus with an open fire for cozy evenings
Extras: Storage shed.

Whether you`re looking for a permanent residence or a seaside getaway, this property is a must-see!
